description: This file contains helper functions for the Coverage API router, including functions to retrieve route callables, convert signatures and dataclasses to pydantic models, create combined models, and generate route schema mappings.

methods.name: get_route_callable
methods.description: Retrieves the callable object for a given route within an app.

methods.name: signature_to_fields
methods.description: Converts a route's callable signature into a dictionary of pydantic fields.

methods.name: dataclass_to_fields
methods.description: Converts a dataclass into a dictionary of pydantic fields.

methods.name: create_combined_model
methods.description: Creates a combined pydantic model from multiple field sets, optionally filtering by provider.

methods.name: get_route_schema_map
methods.description: Generates a mapping of routes to their input/output models and callables.
